SELECT 
    ra.artrefconcerned AS artifact_id,
    TETL.tetl_score
FROM 
    riskassessments ra
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        artrefconcerned,
        SUM(
            conservepriorityscore * tetl
        ) AS tetl_score
    FROM 
        riskassessments
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT 
            unnest(array['Low', 'Medium', 'High']) AS tetl,
            unnest(array[1, 2, 3]) AS tetl_multiplier
    ) AS tetl_values
    WHERE 
        riskassesslevel = tetl
    GROUP BY 
        artrefconcerned
) AS TETL ON ra.artrefconcerned = TETL.artrefconcerned
ORDER BY 
    tetl_score DESC
LIMIT 10;
